name: Brand review — autumn packaging sign-off
turns: Here is the approved Harvest Blend bag for autumn 2026. Treat it as the reference for every seasonal bag: Fern Green body, Oat label, the blend name in Kiln Red.
Noted: the Harvest Blend bag is approved and is the reference layout for seasonal packaging.
And this is the old Fernway & Co. wordmark from 2019. It is retired as of today. Do not use it anywhere new; use the green-circle Fernway logo instead.
Understood: the Fernway & Co. wordmark is retired as of 2026-09-15 and replaced by the green-circle logo.
Two rules for the winter work: Kiln Red is an accent only, never a background, and leave clear space around the logo equal to the height of the circle.
pinned: Fernway brand palette: Fern Green #2B5D4F (primary), Kiln Red #C8553D (accent only), Oat #F4EFE6 (backgrounds), Roast Brown #4A3428 (body text).
Kiln Red #C8553D is an accent color only; never use it as a background.
Clear space around the Fernway logo equals the height of the green circle, on every side.
The Fernway & Co. serif wordmark (2019–2023) is retired as of 2026-09-15; use the green-circle Fernway logo instead.
